title: Kaijuu 8-gou: Hoshina no Kyuujitsu
justification: AniList 179999 (SPECIAL, 1 episode(s) from 2025-03-28) is AniDB 19471's special S1, aired 2025-03-28. AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 179998, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 19471, and the special's title (番外編 保科の休日, "Extra Episode: Hoshina's Day Off") is the AniList native title 怪獣8号 保科の休日 without the series prefix. S1 lands on TVDB 423075 0x01 "Hoshina's Day Off", aired 2025-03-28 (same day). The parent's node has no TMDB show, so the bridged record publishes no TMDB value.
